Must-Visit Café in Cat Ba – Amazing Coffee and Friendly Staff
Mar 2026 • Family
We stumbled upon Catba Specialty Coffee during our time in Cat Ba Island, and it turned out to be one of the highlights of our visit.
The café is beautifully aesthetic with great vibes, making it a perfect place to relax. What truly stood out was the warm hospitality and friendly staff, who made us feel very welcome from the moment we walked in.
We tried their condensed milk coffee, which was absolutely top-notch. The chocolate pancake with mango was delightful, and the orange cinnamon tea was refreshing and unique. We also had the vegetarian pesto pasta, which was delicious and flavourful, clearly made with fresh local herbs and cheese. The staff even prepared a vegetable sandwich specially for us, although it wasn’t on the menu—such a thoughtful gesture!
If you’re visiting Cat Ba, this café is a must-visit for great coffee, tasty food, and wonderful hospitality.
